title: Stock-Rotation Allowance Caps for Committed-Spend Agreements
content:
A customer whose Contract Pricing Agreement carries an annual spend commitment has a higher cap on the stock-rotation allowance of its Ship-To Fulfillment Accounts.

**Clause.** The allowance is capped at 8000.00 where the customer's active Contract Pricing Agreement carries an annual spend commitment of at least 250000.00, and at 4000.00 where it carries at least 50000.00 and less than 250000.00. An agreement with a smaller commitment, an agreement with no commitment, or no active agreement brings no higher cap under this clause.

| Annual spend commitment on the active agreement (USD) | Allowance cap (USD) |
|---|---|
| 250000.00 or more | 8000.00 |
| at least 50000.00 and less than 250000.00 | 4000.00 |
| less than 50000.00, none, or no active agreement | no higher cap under this clause |

**Boundary cases (hypothetical commitments)**

- 250000.00: cap 8000.00. 249999.99: cap 4000.00.
- 50000.00: cap 4000.00. 49999.99: no higher cap under this clause.

The commitment is the annual spend commitment shown on the customer's Contract Pricing Agreement whose status is active.
